notes: Rule 9: the class card is a permanent the character enters the dimension with; one token of fixed value 6 per listed colour (fixed_power_6), never destroyable (using_rule_24 with is_class_card true always fails — the data note 'destroy cost = point-buy all colours at 6' is superseded). ability_kind: once_per_round (caster.class_used_this_round must be false), tap (caster.class_tapped must be false; untap by emitting each listed colour once), static (always on while the card is held). Only reaver/barbarian/monk (EP stance), guardian (regen), noble (lifesteal), assassin (+1 after first hit) are wired in peer.mjs — their implemented semantics are encoded here; the other abilities follow the paper text. Assumed context fields beyond the README shape: caster.class_used_this_round, caster.class_tapped, caster.moved_this_round, caster.dealt_damage_this_round, caster.nearby_traps, caster.discard_actions/discard_effects/discard_skills, caster.hand_effects, caster.hand_non_action, caster.skills_played, caster.fallen_allies_on_tile, caster.archived_creatures, target.deck_size, target.has_armor_token, cast.target_token_power, cast.ally_agrees, dimension.library_size, outcome.combat_damage_dealt.
